versions.changelog:
Initial release: Work Productivity Self Improving Workflow Helper

- Provides actionable help for users needing self-improving, proactive agent-style workflows with proven demand.
- Delivers practical support for fixing bugs, hardening reliability, improving setup safety, and creating related workflows or checklists.
- Guides users through outcome clarification, plan creation, assumption management, and final artifact delivery.
- Outputs are tailored, validated, and focus on local hardware friendliness and reusability.
- Clearly marks required inputs, assumptions, usage notes, and validation checks in every result.
